row.name: C J's Little Ones Day Care

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the inspection, five boards on the wooden fence on the playground are damaged and need to be replaced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: At the inspection,  the operational policy reviewed did not include information informing parents about the operation having a dog present at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §746.501(a)(17))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: At the inspection, the emergency practice for fire drills have not been documented since November 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: At the inspection, the climbing equipment present on the playground did not have loose-fill present for the slide exits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: At the inspection, the caregivers did not follow the daily schedule for giving children the opportunity to be outside during the morning time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: At the inspection, 1 out of 3 children's records reviewed did not have a health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Volunteers and contractors not counted in the child/caregiver ratio must comply with minimum standards that apply to employees: At the inspection, a volunteer was on a cell phone while caring for kids.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Volunteers and contractors not counted in the child/caregiver ratio must comply with minimum standards that apply to employees (26 TAC §746.1401(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: At the inspection, the operation did not have a statement of good health from the vet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §746.3903(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the inspection, the wood fencing on the porch going to the playground are in need of repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: At the inspection, the operation did not have a current vaccincation record for the dog present at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §746.3903(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: At the inspection, the director has 22 hours of annual training and needs 8 hours to complete the training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: At the inspection, 1 out of 4 personnel records reviewed needs 1 hour of annual training to complete the training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: At the inspection, one caregiver had 8 hours worth of certificates for training and needs 16 hours of annual training to complete the training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Toilets - 13 or More Children: At the inspection, the operation had 23 children present and only one working toilet in the building. The 2nd toilet was not in working order.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toilets - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.4407(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: At the inspection, the director did not have any training hours for the 2023 training year to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: At the inspection, the operation did not have proof of the first aid training cards for four staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers: At the inspection, the first aid kit did not have a pair of tweezers included.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: At the inspection, 1 out 4 children's records reviewed did not have the complete information for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At the inspection, one out of four children's records reviewed did not have a copy of the immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: At the inspection, two out of five personnel records reviewed did not have the notarized affidavit included in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the follow-up inspection, the grass on the playground was high and thick and needs to be mowed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At the inspection, 1 out of 8 children's immunization records reviewed were not included in the child's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: At the inspection, the emergency preparedness plan did not have the name and address of the alternate shelter, how children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated shelter, or how  children will be accounted for while at the alternate shelter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: At the inspection, 1 out 3 caregiver training records reviewed did not have the required 24 hours of training certificates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the inspection, part of the siding has come off of the building and an opening to under the building is exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: At the inspection, the fire extinguisher in the kitchen was last serviced December 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: At the inspection, the operations last fire inspection is dated 1/13/2022 and has expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: At the inspection,  the trash can located in the kitchen/lunchroom area did not have a lid and several  flies were flying around the area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: At the inspection, the operation had the TV on and was kept on for an hour and a half.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: At the inspection, the operation did not have a current employee list posted. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision: At the inspection, the iron fire truck play equipment is damaged and unsafe for active play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision (26 TAC §746.4601(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the employees that left the operation in 2022 as required by the deadline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: At the follow-up inspection, the operation needs to add B-F to complete information for indoor/outdoor physical activity.     At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information regarding the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 3 out of 4 children's records reviewed did not have a healthcare provider statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: At the inspection, 2 out of 3 staff training records were reviewed and found deficient. Two staff need 24 hours of training for the year 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: 3 out of 4 children's records did not have information related to special care statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information regarding the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 1 out off 4 children's records reviewed did not have the address to the emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 1 out of 4 personnel records reviewed did not have current first aid training.  The training expired in December of 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: At the inspection, the director training record was reviewed and found deficient.  The director has 2 hours and needs 28 hours of training for the year 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))
